big_case.notes: Pro se debtor's emergency application to stay a district judge from ruling on his bankruptcy appeal while a recusal-mandamus rehearing petition was pending in the Fourth Circuit; denied by the Chief Justice in eight days with no response, referral or writing. Private dispute, no doctrinal or public stakes.

No qp-topics read. Nothing resolving this application surfaced.
